**Calculation of non-GAAP operating income, FY2026 (year ended January 31, 2026)**

Starting point: GAAP operating income of $721 million [DOC-1], plus the following add-backs disclosed in the reconciliation:

| Item | Amount ($M) |
|---|---|
| GAAP operating income | 721 [DOC-1] |
| Share-based compensation expense | 1,570 [DOC-1] |
| Employer payroll tax-related items on employee stock transactions | 62 [DOC-1] |
| Amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets | 106 [DOC-1] |
| Acquisition-related costs | 62 [DOC-1] |
| Restructuring costs | 303 [DOC-1] |
| **Non-GAAP operating income** | **2,824** |

Comparability note: This is a single-period, single-entity figure drawn from one reconciliation table, so no cross-period, cross-entity, or fiscal-calendar comparability issues arise. The only caveat is definitional rather than comparative — the figure is a non-GAAP measure that excludes $303 million of restructuring costs and $1,570 million of share-based compensation [DOC-1], so it is not comparable to GAAP operating income of $721 million [DOC-1] and would not be comparable to a prior-year non-GAAP figure if the company's adjustment definitions differed in that year.

ANSWER: $2,824 million
